name: Magdalena (Margaret) Adams
notable_stories: She was the first child mentioned in Hamilton family reports
Family researchers believe she moved to Ohio following her mother, Elizabeth
After her early death, her twin sister Mary reportedly stepped in to marry her widower and raise her children
milestones: Married Lewis Swan at St. Lukes Church in Granville, OH (m. 25 Sep 1838)
Migrated from Virginia to Licking County, Ohio via the National Road
sources: Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Siblings listed: George Francis (#1), Alexander Washington, Mary (twin), Harriet Josephine, Susan (twin), and Ursula (twin)
No record of the death or burial of a Magdalena Swan (or Adams) found in or around Licking or Franklin County [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 8414]
Unclear reference: The Magdalena Adams named in Francis A. Hamilton’s 1830 will is assumed by the compiler to be Jose P. Adams’s daughter. [Bill Allen, line 9714]
